manifest.name: @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: edit the user-global instructions file (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from the Web settings UI. Maintained, installable fork of couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt — ships prebuilt lib/, declares dsh 0.2.x-compatible peers/engines, and installs from both npm and GitHub.
manifest.author: couplingartist (https://github.com/couplingartist)

bundle.text:
# @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt bundle layer: one plugin row. The host half
# (package main) reads and writes the user-global instructions file; the
# client half (package.json `dsh.client`, served as /plugins/<id>/client.js)
# registers the 全局指令 settings section.
- insert:
    - id: global-prompt
      name: '@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt'

readme.text:
**English** | [中文](#中文)

> Edit the user-global instructions file (`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`) from the DeepSeek Harness Web settings UI — no need to open the `.dsh` folder by hand.

> Based on [couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt) (MIT, © couplingartist); this repository fixes its packaging so the plugin actually installs, and continues the work.

| Situation | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Settings → **全局指令** (Global instructions) | A new settings section: multiline editor + Save button + file path + character count |
| First save | Creates `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` if it does not exist (UTF-8, no BOM) |
| Single source of truth | The settings page reads/writes the same file external editors do — no second copy |
| Effect timing | Follows the harness's touch-driven reload: new sessions read the latest content immediately; open sessions re-read on their next successful file tool call or turn |
| Security | The HTTP API answers loopback (127.0.0.1) only; request bodies capped at 1 MiB |

| Defect (upstream) | Fix (here) |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/` gitignored, no `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` installs an empty shell (`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`) | Prebuilt `lib/` is committed, and `prepack` rebuilds before `npm publish` |
| The npm name `dsh-global-prompt` belongs to an unrelated project | Published as `@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt` |
| Peers pinned to `0.1.1-rc.2` → dsh 0.2.x rejects the install | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` ranges `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` + `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` lists modules that no longer exist in the shell | Now lists `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` (verified against the 0.2.0-rc.2 frozen module table) |
| Client bundle id hardcoded to the old name; source map leaks local paths | Registers under the full package id; source maps disabled |
| No LICENSE / CHANGELOG / engines | Added (MIT) |
```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

readme.section: or straight from GitHub (works because lib/ is committed)
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-global-prompt
```

Restart the web instance so the new plugin loads:

```powershell
dsh web
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` → Settings → **全局指令**. (Adjust `--profile web` to the profile you actually run.)

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
dsh web
```

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm test         # vitest: store (13) + editor (7)
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build        # lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (client bundle)

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `src/store.ts` | Seam 1: read/write semantics of the user-global instructions file (unit-tested) |
| `src/index.ts` | Host plugin: registers `GET/PUT /api/global-prompt` |
| `src/client/GlobalPromptEditor.tsx` | Seam 2: the editor component (unit-tested) |
| `src/client/api.ts` | HTTP implementation of the editor IO boundary |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Client plugin: registers the `settings.section` entry |
| `tsdown.config.ts` | Build: ESM host lib + CJS client factory wrapped in `__ModuleLoader__.load` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle layer: inserts the `global-prompt` row |

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Original work by **couplingartist** ([dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)); packaging, compatibility and maintenance fixes by **HelloQingTao**.

**[English](#zfgctadsh-global-prompt)** | 中文

> 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 设置界面里直接编辑**用户全局指令文件**（`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`），不必再手动打开 `.dsh` 目录改文件。

> 基于 [couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt](https://github.com/couplingartist/dsh-global-prompt)（MIT，© couplingartist）；本仓库修复了它的打包问题使其真正可安装，并继续维护。

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 设置 → **全局指令** | 新增一个设置分区页：多行编辑器 + 保存按钮 + 文件路径显示 + 字符数统计 |
| 首次保存 | 文件不存在时自动创建 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`（UTF-8 无 BOM） |
| 唯一真源 | 设置页与外部编辑器读写同一份文件，没有第二份数据 |
| 生效时机 | 遵循系统触摸驱动刷新：新会话立即读到最新内容；已打开会话在下一次成功文件工具调用或新一轮时重新读取 |
| 安全 | HTTP 接口仅允许本机回环（127.0.0.1）访问；请求体上限 1 MiB |

| 缺陷（上游） | 修复（本仓库） |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/` 被 gitignore 且没有 `prepare`/`prepack` → `dsh plugin add github:...` 装出来是空壳（`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`） | 预构建的 `lib/` 直接入库，并在 `npm publish` 前用 `prepack` 重新构建 |
| npm 上的 `dsh-global-prompt` 包名属于另一个无关项目 | 改名发布为 `@zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt` |
| peer 钉死 `0.1.1-rc.2` → 被 dsh 0.2.x 拒装 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` 改为范围 `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，并声明 `engines.dsh` |
| `dsh.client.inject` 引用了外壳里已不存在的模块 | 改为 0.2.0-rc.2 冻结模块表实际存在的 `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-primitives` |
| 客户端 bundle id 硬编码旧名；sourcemap 泄漏本地路径 | 按完整包名注册；关闭 sourcemap |
| 缺 LICENSE / CHANGELOG / engines | 已补齐（MIT） |
```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt

readme.section: 或者直接从 GitHub 安装（lib/ 已入库，开箱即用）
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:HelloQingTao/dsh-global-prompt
```

重启 web 实例使新插件生效：

```powershell
dsh web
```

然后打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` → 设置 → **全局指令**。（`--profile web` 请换成你实际使用的 profile。）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove @zfgcta/dsh-global-prompt
dsh web
```

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm test         # vitest：store（13）+ editor（7）
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build        # lib/index.js（宿主半）+ lib/client.js（客户端 bundle）

| 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `src/store.ts` | 接缝 1：用户全局指令文件的读写语义（单测覆盖） |
| `src/index.ts` | Host 插件：注册 `GET/PUT /api/global-prompt` |
| `src/client/GlobalPromptEditor.tsx` | 接缝 2：编辑器组件（单测覆盖） |
| `src/client/api.ts` | 编辑器 IO 边界的 HTTP 实现 |
| `src/client/index.tsx` | Client 插件：注册 `settings.section` 分区 |
| `tsdown.config.ts` | 构建：ESM 宿主 lib + 包在 `__ModuleLoader__.load` 里的 CJS 客户端工厂 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：插入 `global-prompt` 行 |
